findings.evidence: Intro paragraph 'Turn a Markdown document with embedded mermaid diagrams into a PDF ... The source .md is never touched.' restates the description and the NEVER list
findings.fix: Delete the intro paragraph; the description and the 'NEVER edit the source .md' item already carry it

findings.evidence: 'Before you run, decide' gives three questions, but there is no check step after the run (open the PDF, confirm every diagram was replaced, confirm the page count is sane)
findings.fix: Add a short post-run check: confirm the result line names the expected backend and diagram format, and that no raw ```mermaid fence is left in the output, before reporting success

findings.evidence: The NEVER list is strong, but it has no gotcha for marp deck links: '--to html keeps your relative image links as written' appears only in body prose
findings.fix: Add a NEVER item: never move a --to html deck away from its <output stem>-assets/ folder or its relative images, because they stop resolving

findings.evidence: The description has WHAT, WHEN and keywords but no boundary against near-miss neighbours (DOCX/HTML to PDF, editing or merging PDFs, polishing an existing marp theme, a lone mermaid diagram to PNG)
findings.fix: Convert a Markdown document (with embedded mermaid diagrams) into a PDF, or into a marp slide deck (pdf, pptx, html), in one non-destructive command; every ```mermaid block is rendered with mmdc and embedded. Use when the user wants to turn a .md file into a PDF or slides: "export markdown to pdf", "md to pdf", "render mermaid and make a PDF", "build a deck from this markdown", even when they only say 'make the design doc printable'. Auto-detects the best installed backend (Pandoc+LaTeX > Typst > WeasyPrint > Chromium) and never auto-installs. Keywords: markdown to pdf, md to pdf, mermaid, marp deck, slide deck, pandoc, typst. Not for editing, merging or filling existing PDFs, converting DOCX/HTML to PDF, theming an existing marp deck, or rendering a single standalone mermaid diagram.

findings.evidence: examples/sample-with-mermaid.md is tracked in the skill but SKILL.md never references it
findings.fix: Reference it with a condition (for example 'to smoke-test an install, run the script on examples/sample-with-mermaid.md'), or delete it

findings.evidence: 'Hand the .rendered.md to marp-slide for themes/polish/export' gives no default output target or cleanup of the .rendered.md/.rendered-assets/ files written next to the source
findings.fix: State the default (pass --to pdf unless the user asked otherwise) and whether to delete <source>.rendered.md and its assets folder after marp-slide finishes

findings.evidence: The script returns only exit codes plus a free-text 'Wrote ... (backend: ..., diagrams: ...)' line, with no structured (JSON) output option; tests/test_markdown_to_pdf_e2e.py holds a single test
findings.fix: Add a --json flag that emits {output, backend, diagram_format, exit_reason} on stdout, and add e2e cases for the deck and --render-only paths

findings.evidence: The troubleshooting table maps exit code 2 only to mermaid or browser failures, but argparse also exits 2 on a bad flag (for example an invalid --backend), so that branch sends the agent to fix a mermaid block that is fine
findings.fix: Add a row: 'Exit code 2 with a usage: line → a bad flag; re-run with a valid --backend/--format value', or give mermaid failures a distinct exit code
